title: The edit that went back in time
hints: Keep a reference to the list you passed in, call `patchItemAt`, then look at your old reference again. Is it still the old data?
The function builds a new *item* correctly, but where does it put it? Assigning a variable to an array doesn't copy the array; both names point at the same one.
Make `next` a real copy of the list before writing into it: `const next = [...list];`
